title: Build with a View Modpack
description: This project contains my modpack "build with a view", which is a building focused modpack with nice visuals and plenty of mods.
body:
# About this modpack
Build with a View is a designed to be a modpack that gives the player many choices on what to do, whether that's building with new blocks and varations, farming and cooking with **Farmer's Delight**, Designing automatic factories with the **Create Mod** or simply exploring the vast world generation of **Still Life**.

**NOTE:**
Build with a View is just a fun little hobby project in very early stages, Do not expect a flawless experience with zero bugs. I will try to update and improve this modpack when possible. 

If you have any suggestions or bugs you've found, visit the **Build with a View** Github page. (https://github.com/willpicks/Build-with-a-View).
